title: Forge Cognitive Engine Prime
description: The Forge Cognitive Engine Prime is a Signature-original cognitive engine in the ai models family. It tracks the working profile of Llama 3.1 405B — open-weight language model: 405 billion parameters released as open weights. Introduced in 2024, it serves developers and researchers.

demo.title: Interactive record tour — Forge Cognitive Engine Prime
